title.narrative: Investing for impact against Tuberculosis- Scaling up Private Sector participation in TB Control - Nigeria (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Nigeria, Tuberculosis, Institute of Human Virology Nigeria (IHVN)This program has the following goals: To accelerate efforts at ending TB epidemic in Nigeria by ensuring access to comprehensive and high quality patients' centered and community owned TB (TB. TB/HIV and DR-TB) services for all Nigerians by 2025. To increase the PPM contribution to the National TB case notification from 14% in 2019 to 35% in 2023. The objectives of this program are: Coverage: 1a) Increase FBOs engaged in TB services from 81% to 100% 1b) Maintain PFPs engaged in TB services at 15% 1c) Maintain the standalone laboratories engaged in TB services at 19% 1d) Maintain PMVs, CPs & TBAs/Religious houses engaged in TB referral at 38%. Diagnosis: 2a) Notify 213,212 new TB cases 2b) Notify 7,356 DR TB cases 2c) Increase childhood TB cases notified to 15% of all notified TB cases 2d) Clinically screen 100% of OPD attendees at private facilities. Treatment and Prevention: 3a) Place 100% of notified DR TB cases on treatment 3b) Increase the under 5 childhood contacts of TB cases on IPT to 100% 3c) Attain 90% Treatment Success Rate by 2023
